interval.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
interval.description: How often to check for Flatpak apps that started or exited. Window changes show up right away.

stop_timeout.label: Stop timeout (seconds)
stop_timeout.description: How long an app gets to quit on its own before it is force-killed.

ignored_apps.label: Ignored apps
ignored_apps.description: Flatpak app ids that are meant to run in the background, for example com.example.App. They are never listed or counted.

glyph.label: Icon
glyph.description: Icon shown in the bar widget.

always_show.label: Always show
always_show.description: Keep the widget in the bar while no Flatpak app runs in the background. When off, it only appears while there are background apps.

show_count.label: Show count
show_count.description: Show the number of background apps next to the icon. The count is never shown while it is 0.

widget.scan_error: Could not check for background apps
widget.empty: No Flatpak apps in the background

panel.title: Background apps
panel.empty: No Flatpak apps are running in the background.
panel.scan_error: Could not check for background apps. The list may be out of date.

notify.missing_command: {command} is not installed or not on PATH

ipc.empty_list: No Flatpak apps are running in the background
